payload.task_text:
I want to set up a healthy eating program for my team. Please use our recipe database to find recipes from at least three different categories and create a comprehensive overview for the program.

First, create a Google Form called Dietary Preference Survey with a description about gathering team food preferences. Add a required single-choice (multiple choice) question asking "Which meal types do you prefer" with the options Breakfast, Lunch, Dinner, and Snacks. Add a required single-choice (multiple choice) question asking "Which dietary restrictions apply to you" with the options Vegetarian, Vegan, Gluten-Free, Dairy-Free, and None. Add a required single-choice (multiple choice) question asking "How many home-cooked meals do you have per week" with the options 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, and 7 (a rating on a scale from 1 to 7). Add an optional text question asking "Are there any specific ingredients you want to avoid".

Then browse through the recipe collection and select at least six recipes representing at least three different categories. Create a Notion page titled Healthy Recipe Knowledge Base. The page should contain blocks for each selected recipe that list the recipe name, the category it belongs to, and a brief description of the recipe.

Also create an Excel file called Recipe_Overview.xlsx in my workspace. This file should have two sheets. The first sheet should be called Recipes and contain columns for Recipe_Name, Category, and Description, with one row for each of the selected recipes. The second sheet should be called Category Summary and show each category name and how many recipes you found in it: put the category name in the first column and the count in the second column, one row per category (do not add extra Total/合计 rows). All numeric values in this file (including the category counts) must be entered as plain literal numbers, not as Excel formulas.

Send an email to wellness.team@company.com with the subject Healthy Eating Program - Recipe Selection. The body should describe the initiative and mention the recipes selected.

Task-Solving Rationable with Sub-task Decomposition:
To solve this task efficiently, complete it directly in the main agent; do not dispatch sub-agents. Freeze the task-visible agent-workspace absolute path from the Visible Boundary/current working directory; never assume `/workspace`. Query exact categories `早餐`, `素菜`, and `主食` in one native-parallel response, select exactly two distinct suitable IDs per category, then retrieve only those six exact IDs in a second native-parallel response. Require six distinct source-backed `{recipe_id,chinese_name,english_name,category,description}` rows and freeze them once.

From those rows, start the independent form, Notion, workbook, and email branches in the same orchestration response. The main agent is the sole owner of each output: exactly one `Dietary Preference Survey` with the four questions/options/required flags in task order; exactly one `Healthy Recipe Knowledge Base` page with one explicit block per recipe; `<agent_workspace>/Recipe_Overview.xlsx` with only `Recipes(Recipe_Name,Category,Description)` and `Category Summary` containing exactly the three category rows with literal count `2` and no total row; and exactly one email to `wellness.team@company.com` with subject `Healthy Eating Program - Recipe Selection` naming all six recipes. Read the form, page, and workbook once and reconcile them to the frozen six rows. Do not search Sent mail or add writer/verification agents.

nodes.text:
You are setting up part of a company "Healthy Eating Program". Your job: create one Google Form with exactly these specifications, using the google_forms MCP tools (mcp__google_forms__create_form, mcp__google_forms__add_multiple_choice_question, mcp__google_forms__add_text_question), then verify with mcp__google_forms__get_form.

Step 1 - Create the form:
- Title: Dietary Preference Survey
- Description: To support our Healthy Eating Program, we are gathering team food preferences to select recipes and plan healthy meals together. Please take a moment to share your meal preferences and dietary needs. Your answers will help us choose recipes that work for everyone.

Step 2 - Add questions in this exact order:
1. A REQUIRED multiple-choice (single-choice) question titled exactly: Which meal types do you prefer
   Options (exact order): Breakfast, Lunch, Dinner, Snacks
2. A REQUIRED multiple-choice (single-choice) question titled exactly: Which dietary restrictions apply to you
   Options (exact order): Vegetarian, Vegan, Gluten-Free, Dairy-Free, None
3. A REQUIRED multiple-choice (single-choice) question titled exactly: How many home-cooked meals do you have per week
   Options (exact order, strings): 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7
   This is a rating on a scale from 1 to 7.
4. An OPTIONAL text question titled exactly: Are there any specific ingredients you want to avoid
   (Do not set required=true for this one.)

Acceptance criteria: form exists with the exact title, description, and the four questions in the order above with required flags as specified. Report back the form ID and a summary of what was created (question titles, option counts, required flags).
Create Dietary Preference Survey form

You are setting up part of a company "Healthy Eating Program". Your job: create one Notion page titled "Healthy Recipe Knowledge Base" at workspace level, containing blocks for 8 selected recipes. Use the Notion MCP tool mcp__notion__API-post-page with parent {"workspace": true}. After creation, verify with mcp__notion__API-get-block-children on the new page ID.

Page structure to create (properties: title = "Healthy Recipe Knowledge Base"; children = the blocks below):

1. Intro paragraph block: "Welcome to the Healthy Recipe Knowledge Base for our Healthy Eating Program. Below are selected healthy recipes from our recipe database, spanning five categories: Meat Dish (荤菜), Vegetable Dish (素菜), Soup (汤), Breakfast (早餐), and Staple Food (主食). Each entry lists the recipe name, its category, and a brief description."

For EACH of the 8 recipes below, add three blocks in order:
- heading_2 with the recipe name (as listed)
- bulleted_list_item rich_text: "Category: <category>"
- bulleted_list_item rich_text: "Description: <description>"

Recipes (use exactly):

1. Name: 凉拌鸡丝 (Cold Shredded Chicken)
   Category: 荤菜 (Meat Dish)
   Description: A quick, low-oil, low-calorie dish of poached chicken breast shredded and tossed with a dressing of Sichuan-pepper oil, light soy sauce and vinegar. High in lean protein and ready in about 30 minutes.

2. Name: 蒜蓉西兰花 (Broccoli with Garlic Sauce)
   Category: 素菜 (Vegetable Dish)
   Description: Blanched broccoli florets topped with a fragrant stir-fried garlic, light soy sauce and oyster sauce drizzle. An easy, fiber-rich vegetarian side dish (difficulty 2/5).

3. Name: 凉拌豆腐 (Cold Tossed Tofu)
   Category: 素菜 (Vegetable Dish)
   Description: A refreshing cold tofu salad that is rich in plant protein and calcium, low in fat and healthy. Simple and quick — about 10 minutes from start to table.

4. Name: 紫菜蛋花汤 (Seaweed and Egg Drop Soup)
   Category: 汤 (Soup)
   Description: A light, quick home-style soup of dried seaweed and beaten eggs with scallions, with optional shrimp for extra protein. Ready in minutes (difficulty 2/5).

5. Name: 小米粥 (Millet Porridge)
   Category: 汤 (Soup)
   Description: A nourishing millet congee high in protein, B vitamins and carotene — gentle on the stomach and suitable for all ages (difficulty 2/5).

6. Name: 牛奶燕麦 (Milk Oatmeal)
   Category: 早餐 (Breakfast)
   Description: A filling, high-protein breakfast of oats with milk and egg, rich in coarse grain fiber. A lazy-friendly, nutritious breakfast ready in about 3 minutes (difficulty 1/5).

7. Name: 燕麦鸡蛋饼 (Oatmeal Egg Pancake)
   Category: 早餐 (Breakfast)
   Description: A highly nutritious, easy-to-make breakfast pancake of oats, eggs and milk, with optional vegetables. Especially suitable for fitness-minded office workers (difficulty 2/5).

8. Name: 麻辣减脂荞麦面 (Spicy Fat-Loss Buckwheat Noodles)
   Category: 主食 (Staple Food)
   Description: A low-calorie (298 kcal per serving) spicy buckwheat noodle bowl with baby cabbage and lettuce, designed for weight management. No cooking skills needed, done in about 20 minutes (difficulty 2/5).

Note: if a single create call with all children is rejected or truncated, create the page first with the intro paragraph, then append blocks with mcp__notion__API-patch-block-children in batches.

Acceptance criteria: page exists with the exact title and contains all 8 recipes with name, category, and description. Report back the page ID/URL and confirm all 8 recipes are present.
Create Notion recipe knowledge base
